name: Tribes 1998 Modern
author: Native Tribes
notes: The 1998 shell's colour language, sampled from retail 1.41 screenshots (Options, Player
Setup, Join Server) and the retail Shell.vol art: cream labels (text #FFD07B), orange
values (value #D68A00), white headings (heading #F4F2F6), thin green frame lines
(panel edge #2C9912), a solid dark-green selection (primaryBottom #165603), and black space
with a faint violet cast (panel #0C0B10, base #131218). The Options tab column is the stock
solid green nav block (sidebar #165603), and the window frame is the steel-lavender bezel
(frame base #6E7DAE to #2A2B42, lit lip #A9B4DE) with the green rule inside it (inner #2C9912).
Modern by restraint: flat plates with a 2px cut instead of bevelled green pills, a 1px
stroke, a whisper of bevel, and the bright lime (primary edge #82D265) kept for the one lit
